title: Lake Mead Fell To 27% Full—Threatening Hoover Power
hook: Lake Mead fell to 27% full, threatening Hoover Dam power.
closing: Falling water threatens both the reservoir and the electricity people rely on.
question: Did you know Lake Mead fell this low?

segments.say: Lake Mead dropped 153 feet. The reservoir's retreat became visible from shore.
Lake Mead fell to 27 percent full. America's biggest reservoir was barely above one-quarter capacity.
Lake Mead sat 97 feet above the power cutoff. More decline puts Hoover Dam generation at risk.
